tweet.text: I always thought that mutation testing was a good idea; but it was always hard to afford.  Now it's just one more Claude agent working down a list.  And the benefit is amazing.  Lots of coverage.  Lots of overloading.  Lots of refactoring and separation of concerns.  Astounding.
